answer: Deposits are visible in haven, and tundra reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 43% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 50 aliases, and each one needs its own funded ember account. A farm of 4362 identities would post 3833 proofs and burn roughly 31 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
